question: Can a shadow evidence bundle be reconstructed from branded Base/effect authority artifacts and provably bound to an exact durable journal head without circular hashes or concurrent-writer ambiguity?
startingState: Authenticated Base collection and signed effect verification exist, but v0.1 consumes parallel raw observations, journal serialization is process-local, bundles do not reference journal records or authority artifacts, and operation/verification timestamps are not journal-linked.
boundedChange: Add fail-closed cross-process journal locking, compare-and-append head semantics, immutable content-addressed artifact persistence, branded Base/effect audit artifact export, a no-action v0.2 bundle assembler with input-commit and bundle-commit journal anchors, offline closure receipts, lifecycle/recovery validation, and crash/concurrency tests. No live adapter, transaction, payment, retry execution, public route, deployment, or v0.1 assurance mutation.
successCondition: The exact operation attempt, Base collection, signed effect proof, evaluator input, and bundle are content-addressed; the bundle binds the input journal commit; a separate closure receipt binds the bundle commit; concurrent/stale heads and every incomplete/crash boundary fail closed or are recoverably reported; serialized authority-looking objects cannot enter the v0.2 path.
failureCondition: A forged/unbranded authority artifact, stale journal head, second process, event after closure, missing/tampered artifact, interleaved append, or partial commit is accepted as a closed authoritative bundle, or any action/payment path is introduced.
